mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe economic downturn with aggressive monetary easing, which typically precedes a 60-day rebound in S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate policy support.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and UNRATE > 4.5% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession, weak consumer demand (as measured by retail sales, RSAFS) leads to lower corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of recession periods when RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic output.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market collapse (HOUST below 1400 thousand units) indicates a severe downturn in the real estate sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1400 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 return over the next 20 trading days as the market reacts to accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods within a monetary easing cycle when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and INDPRO (both below their 3-month moving averages) fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 5-year rolling window.
